easy.XE1: WITH per_day AS ( SELECT DATE({TIME_EVENT}) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[TIME_EVENT, ID_EXTERNAL]} GROUP BY DATE({TIME_EVENT}) ) SELECT d, cnt, SUM(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_cnt FROM per_day ORDER BY d;
easy.XE2: SELECT a.{NAME_ENTITY} AS entity_a, b.{NAME_ENTITY} AS entity_b, a.{CATEGORY_TOPIC} FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[NAME_ENTITY, CATEGORY_TOPIC]} a JOIN {EVENT_SCOPE[NAME_ENTITY, CATEGORY_TOPIC]} b ON a.{CATEGORY_TOPIC} = b.{CATEGORY_TOPIC} AND a.{NAME_ENTITY} < b.{NAME_ENTITY} ORDER BY a.{CATEGORY_TOPIC} LIMIT 10;
easy.XE3: SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC}, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, VAL_QUANTITY]} WHERE {VAL_QUANTITY} IS NOT NULL GROUP BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
easy.XE4: SELECT {NAME_ENTITY} FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[NAME_ENTITY, VAL_QUANTITY]} WHERE {VAL_QUANTITY} >= ( SELECT AVG({VAL_QUANTITY}) FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[NAME_ENTITY, VAL_QUANTITY]} ) ORDER BY {VAL_QUANTITY} DESC LIMIT 10;
easy.XE5: SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC}, MIN({VAL_QUANTITY}) AS min_v, MAX({VAL_QUANTITY}) AS max_v, MAX({VAL_QUANTITY}) - MIN({VAL_QUANTITY}) AS span FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, VAL_QUANTITY]} GROUP BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} ORDER BY span DESC LIMIT 10;
easy.XE6: SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC}, COUNT(DISTINCT {NAME_ENTITY}) AS distinct_entities, COUNT(*) AS rows_cnt, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT {NAME_ENTITY}) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS uniqueness FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, NAME_ENTITY]} GROUP BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} ORDER BY uniqueness DESC LIMIT 10;
easy.XE7: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC} AS c, {NAME_ENTITY} AS e, {VAL_QUANTITY} AS v, LAG({VAL_QUANTITY}) OVER (PARTITION BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} ORDER BY {VAL_QUANTITY} DESC) AS prev_v FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, NAME_ENTITY, VAL_QUANTITY]} ) SELECT c, e, v, prev_v - v AS gap_to_prev FROM ranked WHERE prev_v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gap_to_prev DESC LIMIT 10;
easy.XE8: SELECT {NAME_ENTITY} FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[NAME_ENTITY, CATEGORY_TOPIC]} WHERE {CATEGORY_TOPIC} IN ( SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC} FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[NAME_ENTITY, CATEGORY_TOPIC]} GROUP BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) ORDER BY {NAME_ENTITY} LIMIT 10;
easy.XE9: SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC}, AVG({VAL_QUANTITY}) AS avg_v FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, VAL_QUANTITY]} GROUP BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} HAVING AVG({VAL_QUANTITY}) > ( SELECT AVG({VAL_QUANTITY}) FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, VAL_QUANTITY]} ) ORDER BY avg_v DESC LIMIT 10;
easy.XE10: WITH q AS ( SELECT {NAME_ENTITY} AS e, {VAL_QUANTITY} AS v, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY {VAL_QUANTITY}) AS quartile FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[NAME_ENTITY, VAL_QUANTITY]} WHERE {VAL_QUANTITY} IS NOT NULL ) SELECT quartile, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(v) AS lo, MAX(v) AS hi FROM q GROUP BY quartile ORDER BY quartile;

mid.XM1: WITH s AS ( SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC} AS c, {VAL_AMOUNT} AS v, LAG({VAL_AMOUNT}) OVER (PARTITION BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} ORDER BY {TIME_EVENT}) AS prev_v FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, VAL_AMOUNT, TIME_EVENT]} ) SELECT c, COUNT(*) AS rises FROM s WHERE prev_v IS NOT NULL AND v > prev_v GROUP BY c ORDER BY rises DESC LIMIT 10;
mid.XM2: WITH q AS ( SELECT {REL_ENTITY} AS e, {VAL_AMOUNT} AS v, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY {VAL_AMOUNT} DESC) AS quintile FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[REL_ENTITY, VAL_AMOUNT]} WHERE {VAL_AMOUNT} IS NOT NULL ) SELECT e, v FROM q WHERE quintile = 1 ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 10;
mid.XM3: WITH r AS ( SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC} AS c, {VAL_QUANTITY} AS v, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} ORDER BY {VAL_QUANTITY}) AS pr FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, VAL_QUANTITY]} ) SELECT c, MIN(v) AS p90_value FROM r WHERE pr >= 0.9 GROUP BY c ORDER BY p90_value DESC LIMIT 10;
mid.XM4: SELECT {ID_EXTERNAL} FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[ID_EXTERNAL, CATEGORY_TOPIC]} WHERE {CATEGORY_TOPIC} IN ( SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC} FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[ID_EXTERNAL, CATEGORY_TOPIC]} GROUP BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ) ORDER BY {ID_EXTERNAL} LIMIT 10;
mid.XM5: SELECT {REL_ENTITY}, SUM({VAL_AMOUNT}) AS total FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[REL_ENTITY, VAL_AMOUNT]} GROUP BY {REL_ENTITY} HAVING SUM({VAL_AMOUNT}) > ( SELECT AVG({VAL_AMOUNT}) * 10 FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[REL_ENTITY, VAL_AMOUNT]} ) ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;
mid.XM6: WITH d AS ( SELECT DATE({TIME_EVENT}) AS day, SUM({VAL_AMOUNT}) AS amt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[TIME_EVENT, VAL_AMOUNT]} GROUP BY DATE({TIME_EVENT}) ) SELECT day, amt, AVG(amt) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7d FROM d ORDER BY day;
mid.XM7: SELECT a.{CATEGORY_TOPIC}, COUNT(*) AS pair_cnt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, REL_ENTITY]} a JOIN {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, REL_ENTITY]} b ON a.{CATEGORY_TOPIC} = b.{CATEGORY_TOPIC} AND a.{REL_ENTITY} < b.{REL_ENTITY} GROUP BY a.{CATEGORY_TOPIC} ORDER BY pair_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
mid.XM8: SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC}, COUNT(DISTINCT {REL_ENTITY}) AS entities, COUNT(*) AS events, CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT {REL_ENTITY}) AS events_per_entity FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, REL_ENTITY]} GROUP BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT {REL_ENTITY}) >= 5 ORDER BY events_per_entity DESC LIMIT 10;
mid.XM9: SELECT {NAME_ENTITY}, MIN({TIME_EVENT}) AS first_seen, MAX({TIME_EVENT}) AS last_seen, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[NAME_ENTITY, TIME_EVENT]} GROUP BY {NAME_ENTITY} ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
mid.XM10: SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC}, SUM(CASE WHEN {VAL_QUANTITY} IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN {VAL_QUANTITY} IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS missing_rate FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, VAL_QUANTITY]} GROUP BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} ORDER BY missing_rate DESC LIMIT 10;

hard.XH1: SELECT a.{REL_ENTITY} AS entity_a, b.{REL_ENTITY} AS entity_b, COUNT(*) AS shared_cnt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[REL_ENTITY, CATEGORY_TOPIC]} a JOIN {EVENT_SCOPE[REL_ENTITY, CATEGORY_TOPIC]} b ON a.{CATEGORY_TOPIC} = b.{CATEGORY_TOPIC} AND a.{REL_ENTITY} < b.{REL_ENTITY} GROUP BY a.{REL_ENTITY}, b.{REL_ENTITY} ORDER BY shared_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
hard.XH2: WITH s AS ( SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC} AS c, {TIME_EVENT} AS ts, {VAL_AMOUNT} AS v, LAG({VAL_AMOUNT}) OVER (PARTITION BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} ORDER BY {TIME_EVENT}) AS prev_v FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, TIME_EVENT, VAL_AMOUNT]} ) SELECT c, COUNT(*) AS drop_cnt FROM s WHERE prev_v IS NOT NULL AND v < prev_v GROUP BY c ORDER BY drop_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
hard.XH3: SELECT {ID_EXTERNAL} FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[ID_EXTERNAL, CATEGORY_TOPIC, VAL_QUANTITY]} t WHERE {VAL_QUANTITY} > ( SELECT AVG(u.{VAL_QUANTITY}) FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[ID_EXTERNAL, CATEGORY_TOPIC, VAL_QUANTITY]} u WHERE u.{CATEGORY_TOPIC} = t.{CATEGORY_TOPIC} ) ORDER BY {VAL_QUANTITY} DESC LIMIT 10;
hard.XH4: WITH q AS ( SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC} AS c, {VAL_AMOUNT} AS v, NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} ORDER BY {VAL_AMOUNT} DESC) AS decile FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, VAL_AMOUNT]} WHERE {VAL_AMOUNT} IS NOT NULL ) SELECT c, SUM(CASE WHEN decile = 1 THEN v ELSE 0 END) AS top_decile_amt, SUM(v) AS total_amt, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN decile = 1 THEN v ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(v), 0) AS concentration FROM q GROUP BY c ORDER BY concentration DESC LIMIT 10;
hard.XH5: SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC}, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, ID_EXTERNAL]} WHERE {ID_EXTERNAL} NOT IN ( SELECT {ID_EXTERNAL} FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[CATEGORY_TOPIC, ID_EXTERNAL]} WHERE {CATEGORY_TOPIC} IS NULL ) GROUP BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
hard.XH6: WITH d AS ( SELECT DATE({TIME_EVENT}) AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[TIME_EVENT, ID_EXTERNAL]} GROUP BY DATE({TIME_EVENT}) ) SELECT day, cnt, SUM(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cnt FROM d ORDER BY day;
hard.XH7: WITH r AS ( SELECT {LOCATION} AS loc, {VAL_QUANTITY} AS v, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY {VAL_QUANTITY}) AS pr FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[LOCATION, VAL_QUANTITY]} ) SELECT loc, COUNT(*) AS top_decile_cnt FROM r WHERE pr >= 0.9 GROUP BY loc ORDER BY top_decile_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
hard.XH8: SELECT {REL_ENTITY}, COUNT(DISTINCT {CATEGORY_TOPIC}) AS topic_cnt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[REL_ENTITY, CATEGORY_TOPIC]} GROUP BY {REL_ENTITY} HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT {CATEGORY_TOPIC}) >= 3 ORDER BY topic_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
hard.XH9: SELECT {NAME_ENTITY}, SUM({VAL_AMOUNT}) AS total FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[NAME_ENTITY, VAL_AMOUNT]} GROUP BY {NAME_ENTITY} HAVING SUM({VAL_AMOUNT}) > ( SELECT AVG({VAL_AMOUNT}) * 100 FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[NAME_ENTITY, VAL_AMOUNT]} ) ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;
hard.XH10: SELECT {LOCATION}, {CATEGORY_TOPIC}, COUNT(*) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY {LOCATION}) AS share_in_location FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[LOCATION, CATEGORY_TOPIC, ID_EXTERNAL]} GROUP BY {LOCATION}, {CATEGORY_TOPIC} ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
